provenance.title: Usual furniture sizes
provenance.covers: A usual width and depth for each kind of furniture the place screen offers, and which pieces are tall and need free space in front. Common sizes in our own words, from general knowledge.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. A usual three-seat sofa. Front is the free space wanted before it.
